acceptance_criteria.criterion: M5 review wakeup remains operational when macOS launchd PATH omits Homebrew gh, without granting merge authority or introducing a review webhook
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Existing LaunchAgent logged repeated FileNotFoundError gh; PATH repaired and service restarted; new CLI resolver handles standard and Homebrew paths; 19 targeted tests passed including missing CLI and fallback, and trusted identity-only dispatch contract.

defect_families.evidence: Reviewed staged M5 wakeup CLI discovery and focused tests; no change to privileged readiness or review acceptance.
